brief.title: 2Z Global Tour: Electrify Your Night!
brief.targetAudience: K-Pop fans, particularly those interested in boy groups and high-energy performances, aged 16-30.
brief.storyline: A fast-paced montage showcasing 2Z's powerful stage presence, intricate choreography, and charismatic close-ups, interspersed with quick cuts of cheering fans, leading to a reveal of concert dates and ticket information.
brief.videoStructure: 0-5s: Quick, impactful cuts of 2Z's most iconic dance moves and stage presence with a strong beat drop. 5-20s: Montage of energetic performance clips, close-ups of members, and fan interactions. 20-40s: Highlight reel of concert moments, showing diverse stages and audience engagement, with dynamic text overlays. 40-55s: Build-up to concert announcement, showing suspenseful visuals and revealing tour dates/cities. 55-60s: Call to action with ticket purchase information and official tour hashtag.
brief.subtitleStyle: Bold, dynamic K-Pop MV-style text, using bright colors (e.g., neon pink, electric blue) that flash and animate with the beat, primarily for key messages and tour details.
brief.voiceoverStyle: Energetic, enthusiastic, and confident male voiceover (English) during transitions and for key announcements, building excitement and urgency.
brief.musicSuggestion: A powerful, original 2Z track with a strong, driving beat and catchy chorus, or an instrumental version of their most popular song that builds intensity throughout the video.
brief.socialMediaTips: Utilize trending TikTok sounds and challenges related to K-Pop. Encourage user-generated content (UGC) by asking fans to share their favorite 2Z moments or anticipation. Use relevant hashtags like #2ZGlobalTour #KPopConcert #2ZLive #ConcertPromo. Collaborate with K-Pop influencers for cross-promotion.
brief.ctaSuggestion: Text overlay: 'GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!' followed by 'Link in Bio' and 'Visit 2Zofficial.com/tour' with a clear, direct call to action to purchase tickets.
